# Clean Collateral Policy

## 1. Vehicle loans

Used vehicle loans are limited to 80% of the appraised value. The system must ignore appraisals older than 90 days.

## 2. Instructions to analysts

Analysts follow the instructions in the collateral checklist before approval. Previous appraisals may be overridden by a Credit Manager.
